name: at89c51_8led
purpose: Keil C51 与 Proteus 的 8 位流水灯需求草案
components_required: AT89C51 (or locally available model after verification)
logical_behavior: 八个 LED 依次点亮，每步 250 ms，循环运行
recommended_port: P1.0..P1.7 (verify actual port, LED polarity, current drive and model pin names)
power_and_reset: Must verify VCC/GND, EA high for internal program memory, oscillator 12 MHz or as chosen, reset behavior and program memory configuration. Never assume pin numbers without checking device library and datasheet.

simulation.verification: multiple timestamped screenshots or scope/probe traces demonstrating sequential LED changes
